item.title: Data digest, issue 1 (2026-10-13)
item.description: 12 WARN notices in the sample cover 416 workers across 1 state(s). The largest is AMF Bowling Centers, Inc. Castle Park (130 workers, notice dated 2026-10-05). 12 Form D filings: median stated offering $5,000,000, $252,216,588 sold in total, newest filed 2026-10-09. 12 newly registered carriers from 9 states; median fleet is 1 power unit(s). 9 of 12 sampled postings (75%) state a salary range.
